summary: Приняты исследовательское досье (SHA256 7bc0a1f8962e68fc102bc6d6b68f78cd9052bea40dfcc1b5e890385d8ebba244), план (SHA256 f9e6b3d722051f75b5a64f767d94f18a8c07fb2b914032ef572b82a3cb330c87) и публичный reference archive. Объект инициализируется Terra; геометрия ещё не создана. Чужие текущие изменения прицепов не приняты и не затрагиваются.

B00 создан и проверен. Приняты предварительный D1 Astra/max и B01 evidence Sol. Terra материализует проект и reference-only Blender scene. Пользователь разрешил закрыть сохранённый прицеп и реально открыть новый .blend в том же Blender. Metadata-only origin sync явно разрешён и первичная ветка отправлена.
D1 saved and open in Blender through verified MCP; D2 kinematic candidate accepted. Geometry remains blocked by missing dimensions.
User has no CAD or survey access and explicitly requests reconstruction from images. Visible original geometry now proceeds from calibrated factory drawings and photos.
D3 real exterior saved/open in the sole existing Blender. D4 Astra/max interior design recorded, no interior Mesh yet. Main next block is B03 chassis/R0; B04, B05 finish and B06 remain pending.

USER REJECTED D3 visual draft and corrected modelling order. Old exterior is hidden in the sole Blender; historical c00d35b is rollback trace, not accepted geometry. Restart with frame, then axles/suspension, steering/shafts, body by separate parts, interior last. Astra/max prepares frame-only source recipe.

User stopped FRAME1 modelling and requires all visible-frame photo/video research followed by one small visible fragment at a time. Astra withdrew unsupported full-frame layout. Photo audit continues; no Blender changes after stop.

User stop honoured. Complete visual classification of 153 found media URL records: 147 originals and six archived previews; legacy 57 records separate. Astra/max selected one rear mounting-plate side fragment by transport eye for a future two-photo 2D contour comparison. Modelling remains stopped.
